source.title: Мова програмування Rust / The Rust Programming Language — Ukrainian translation
source.family_identity_rule: One family for the Rust Book work/translation lineage; mirrors, forks, other hosting URLs, and later editions do not earn additional family credit.

license.declared_surface: The selected second-edition subtree contains LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE. This authority fails closed by satisfying the notice/redistribution conditions of both instead of depending on an OR-vs-AND interpretation.
license.operational_compliance: Retain the Rust Project Developers copyright/permission notice and MIT text; retain Apache-2.0 license and applicable notices; mark modified files if redistributed in modified form; identify rust-lang-ua/rustbook_ukrainian and exact commit as source.

attribution.credit: The Rust Project Developers; Ukrainian translation contributors at rust-lang-ua/rustbook_ukrainian

selection.rule: Exact allowlist of two Chapter 1 source Markdown files under the explicitly licensed second-edition subtree at the pinned commit.
explicit_exclusions: second-edition/src/ch01-03-hello-cargo.md is excluded because its teaching fixture contains an example email address and the privacy gate is intentionally strict
top-level src/ and src-ukr/ are excluded because this authority binds only the second-edition subtree with co-located license files
images, generated book output, build scripts, tooling, glossary/dictionary files, README/contributor metadata, and license text are not training payload

normalization.description: Strict UTF-8; LF; Unicode NFC; remove HTML comments/tags, fenced code, inline-code spans and link targets while preserving link labels; remove Markdown structural punctuation; collapse whitespace per nonempty line; terminate with one LF.

quality.manual_note: The bounded chapters are coherent Ukrainian instructional prose with some legacy translation/editing imperfections; code-heavy and metadata surfaces are removed by normalization. This is a technical-language source, not a gold literary corpus.
